name: Kathy Jennings
stance: Used Delaware's charity-law oversight of OpenAI's recapitalization to keep a nonprofit safety committee able to halt model releases; backs federal frontier-AI rules.

statements.text: Approved OpenAI's recapitalization on conditions that the nonprofit keep control and that its Safety and Security Committee retain authority to halt model releases on safety grounds.
These reforms are designed to help this technology realize its extraordinary potential to benefit humanity

Signed the 26-attorney-general letter urging Congress to immediately establish federal regulation and safety protocols for frontier AI (mandatory safety testing oversight, incident investigations, international coordination against harmful superintelligence) without preempting state law.
Joined the bipartisan 36-attorney-general NAAG letter urging Congress to reject a federal moratorium preempting state AI laws.

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
